B. Hydrochloric acid (HCl) - Known as a strong acid and typically not recognized as a reducing agent.

C. Hypophosphorous acid (H3PO2) - Known to act as a weak reducing agent in certain chemical reactions.

D. Sodium metal (Na) - Known as a very strong reducing agent.
